package.name: san_follower_tier
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Follower Tier FSM per SDD-SWARM §6.2 (6-state). 6-state FSM (T0/T1/T1.5/T2/T3/T4) determining follower tracking behaviour from prediction quality, comm state, and δ. Publishes TierStatusChange per IDS §4.5. KPP-2 (≤ 300ms) measurable via T0→T1.5 transition timing.
PATCH 2026-05-13 (deep-dive review): * step() takes EXPLICIT dt_ms — caller passes real elapsed time (was hardcoded 100ms). KPP-2 measurement now reflects reality. * BIDIRECTIONAL hysteresis on all δ thresholds (was downgrade-only). * Anti-flap dwell extended to T2/T3/T4 (was T1.5 only). * KPP-2 latency probe — steady_clock stamp at obstacle false→true edge, surfaced in TierStatusChange.transition_latency_ms. * Real /comm_link/status + /breadcrumb subscriptions via the new CommHealth tracker (was hardcoded true → T4 unreachable). * Tick handler measures actual elapsed dt (was nominal 100ms). * FSM call moved INSIDE state_mu_ — safe under MultiThreadedExecutor. * prediction_received threshold derives from tick_period_ms × 5 (was hardcoded 500ms regardless of tick). * 단위 테스트 16 → 25 (★ 9 PATCH 검증 testcase 추가).
